thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: PD #INC-3327 fired for service=redwood-edge-loadbalancer-eu (high error rate, TLS handshake failures). Alerting policy: lb_tls_handshake_failures > 5% for 2m. https://pd.example/INC-3327

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident created: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-3327 — assigned to on-call: @alyssa (eu-oncall). Auto-escalation in 10m.

alyssa: Acked. I'm looking. First check LB target group health and recent deploys.

kumar: Seeing spike in 502+TLS errors at the edge: `tls_handshake_error` up ~18% over baseline since 12:07 UTC. Route: eu-west-1, host: api.eu.redwood.ai.

jen: No deploys in last 30m from rollout pipeline. I see a cert rotation job started 20m ago but it reported succeeded.

mike: Can anyone dump ALB target health history? grabbing CloudWatch now.

ops-l2: Pulling the target group and backend instance health: a bunch of targets showing Unhealthy -> Initializing, control-plane still returning 200s. Possible backend app flapping under TLS handshake renegotiation.

alyssa: Customer impact? CS, pinged.

customer-success: We're tracking 3 customers reporting tail-latency and connection errors. Two are seeing increased reconnects in EU. No billing-impact reports yet, but UX is degraded.

kumar: Running quick curl against the LB: `curl -v https://api.eu.redwood.ai/health` shows TLS alert: "handshake_failure" intermittently. When it works, response is 200.

eng-runtime: Seeing increased KV cache misses correlated with handshake spikes; wonder if a sudden prefix caching invalidation caused burst of cold starts? Not sure how that would cause TLS handshakes though.

alyssa: For immediate mitigation, can we shift traffic off the unhealthy target group and failover to standby pool in eu-west-2? That will reduce blast radius.

jen: We can modify ALB weights to steer traffic. Suggest failover to eu-west-2 and reduce TTL for DNS? Note: DNS TTL is 60s on edge alias.

mike: I'll run an emergency target deregistration for the suspect targets in eu-west-1 and toggle route weight. Command:```aws elbv2 modify-listener --listener-arn <arn> --default-actions '[{"Type":"forward","ForwardConfig":{"TargetGroups":[{"TargetGroupArn":"tg-eu-west-2","Weight":100}]}}]'```

ops-l2: Hold on - need to ensure capacity in eu-west-2. Autoscaling group currently at 70% CPU but has room to scale; I'll trigger scale-up policy if needed.

kumar: Also, certs: the rotation job used the new chain from ACME. I suspect a curl from older clients failing SNI fallback with the new chain (ECDSA vs RSA). We should check ALB certificate chain & cipher suite.

eng-runtime: Confirmed ALB is serving new cert chain as of 12:05. We're seeing clientnegotiation errors in the ALB logs with cipher suite mismatch: some clients attempted RSA but cert is ECDSA-first.

alyssa: Mitigation plan: 1) Fail traffic to eu-west-2 pool, 2) temporarily attach previous cert chain to ALB (rollback cert), 3) monitor metrics for 15m, 4) if stable, plan safe cert rotation with dual-chain support.

jen: I've got the previous cert (cert-2026-01) available. Preparing change.

mike: Executing weight change now. (will post command output).

mike: ```output: Modified listener, forwarding to tg-eu-west-2 weight=100.``` :white_check_mark:

ops-l2: Triggered scale-up: +2 instances to eu-west-2 ASG.

alyssa: Rolling the cert back now — attaching cert-2026-01 to listener. Will note maintenance in incident timeline.

jen: Cert rollback done. ALB now presenting cert-2026-01.

kumar: Early signs good: TLS handshake errors dropping from 18% -> 3% over 4 minutes. Connection success rate improving.

customer-success: We're seeing customer error reports decreasing. CS updated customers on mitigation steps. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty INC-3327 acknowledged by alyssa. Status: investigating.

alyssa: Monitoring for next 15m. If stable, we'll close PD and open a follow-up task to re-do cert rotation with ECDSA+RSA dual cert or ALB support check.

eng-runtime: We'll add a compatibility test for cipher suites in the preflight job. Also will add an automated check to detect cert chain changes and alert before rollout.

mike: Rolling back is hairy but worked. Note: we didn't need DNS TTL changes because ALB-level forwarding handled failover.

ops-l2: eu-west-2 instances are healthy; no escalations needed.

alyssa: 15m stable window started at 12:20 UTC. If no regressions, we'll resolve.

pagerduty-bot: PD INC-3327 status changed to "resolved" by alyssa at 12:38 UTC (post-mitigation).

alyssa: Postmortem owner: eng-runtime (kumar + jen). Action items: [1] Dual cert support or fallback, [2] preflight cipher compatibility test, [3] runbook update for cert rotations and ALB rollback. Assigning tasks in tracker.

kumar: I'll draft the postmortem and include timeline + metric graphs.

customer-success: Notifying affected customers and offering RC for any residual issues.

alyssa: Thanks everyone. Closing thread when docs/tasks are created. :pray:
